narrative.morphology: multicellular mucilaginous, amorphous colonies, made of sphaerical, subspherical or hemispherical (after division) cells in multiple envelopes that do not copy exactly the cell shape. Cells with homogeneous blue-green content (Plates 1, 2). Cells and their immediate groups are surrounded by lamellated envelopes.
narrative.ecology: a rare benthic species that occurs only in the littoral zone. When present, colonies are large enough to be seen macroscopically as strongly colored blue-green aggregates on stones in the shallow water.
